definitions.explanation: A state of being unsure or unable to decide. Mental wavering between options or courses of action.
In Buddhist contexts, attachment to worldly things that clouds the mind and prevents enlightenment.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
{迷|まよ}い⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{迷|まよ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: When you have doubt in your heart, your decisions are delayed.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}って→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I cut through my indecision and chose a new path.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{迷|まよ}い⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{解|と}き{放|はな}たれる→解き放つ：14218_tokihanatsu⟧。
examples.english: Through spiritual practice, one is freed from worldly delusion.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{悟|さと}り→悟り：07773_satori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧。
examples.english: From the world of delusion to the world of enlightenment.

notes:
{迷|まよ}い is the noun form of the verb ⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧ (to be lost, to hesitate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迷|まよ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have doubts)
- {迷|まよ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to cast aside hesitation)
- {迷|まよ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧ (to cut through indecision)
- {迷|まよ}い⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without hesitation)
- {迷|まよ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧ (doubts arise)

SENSE DISTINCTION:
- Sense 1 (everyday): mental wavering, being unable to decide
- Sense 2 (Buddhist): spiritual delusion or attachment to the material world
